column1: # NOTHING OUTSTANDING. Every user-visible string in this file already sits in a
# _t(en, hi) pair whose Hindi side is Devanagari.
# The 14 pairs that still mirror English are all `altName` / `name` fields
# holding the term printed verbatim on her report, which the register keeps
#   Placenta Previa, Nuchal Cord, GDM, Oligohydramnios, Preeclampsia,
#   Polyhydramnios, Gestational Hypertension, SGA, LGA, Subchorionic Hematoma,
#   Two-Vessel Cord, EIF, Group B Strep, GBS
# Where the alt name carried an everyday word, the file already translated it
# ('Breech Baby' -> 'Breech शिशु', 'Rh Negative Blood' -> 'Rh Negative ख़ून').
